column1: # Code anchors for known issues the docs cite by file:line.
# Columns (TAB-separated): id <TAB> repo-relative file <TAB> fixed-string pattern
# Patterns, not line numbers: lines drift on every edit, patterns survive.
# scan-known-issues.sh resolves each pattern to its current line and checks
# every `File.ext:NNN` citation in the docs against these anchors.
# Pattern not found → the item was likely fixed or rewritten. Investigate, then
# update both the docs and this file. Keep each pattern unique within its file.
